newsitem.title: CHINA: August industrial output up in China's Guangdong.
newsitem.headline: August industrial output up in China's Guangdong.

text.p: Industrial production of China's booming southern province of Guangdong grew a year-on-year 15.42 percent in August, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
It marked growth of around 15 percent for the fourth consecutive month, Xinhua said.
The sales rate of Guangdong's industrial products surged to 94.61 percent in August from the beginning of the year, it said, quoting official statitics.

State enterprises in Guangdong were performing better, and their economic returns have increased because the government had taken a series of measures to improve the macro-economic environment and support state firms, the agency said.
Guangdong's major economic indicators were better than average, Xinhua quoted the Guangdong Provincial Statistics Bureau as saying.
